artifacts.derivation: Copied unchanged from the McClatchy southeast newsroom's published file of the place summary level of the 2020 Census redistricting data (P.L. 94-171, table P2, race by Hispanic or Latino origin), North Carolina only. Counts of all residents, not adults. Found by a search of public GitHub repositories because the Census Bureau's own hosts are not reachable from the build containers. Replace with an all-places file of the same columns, or extend the exporter to read an ACS B03002 cut, when one is committed; each added state is one more file in raw/.
artifacts.table: P2 Hispanic or Latino, and not Hispanic or Latino by race, place level, North Carolina
artifacts.publisher: McClatchy southeast newsroom (derived from U.S. Census Bureau counts)
